products.description: Complete 5-year solved university question bank. Covers pointers, memory allocation, arrays, structs, recursion, and common 10-mark algorithm proofs.
syllabusHighlights: Pointers & Dynamic Memory Allocation (malloc, calloc, realloc)
Recursion vs Iteration with Stack Trace Analysis
Structures, Unions, & Bit Fields with Model Programs
File Handling & Preprocessor Directives Exam Solutions

products.description: Master Boolean algebra, K-Maps (up to 5 variables), flip-flops, multiplexers, and counters with step-by-step circuit timing diagrams.
syllabusHighlights: Karnaugh Map Minimization with Don't Care Conditions
Design of Synchronous & Asynchronous Mod-N Counters
Encoders, Decoders, Multiplexers & Demultiplexers
Logic Families (TTL vs CMOS) Comparative Analysis

products.description: Matrix algebra, eigen values, differential calculus, and graph theory problem sets solved specifically for university semester exams.
syllabusHighlights: Cayley-Hamilton Theorem & Matrix Inversion
Limits, Continuity, & Taylor Series Expansions
Eulerian & Hamiltonian Graphs with Path Proofs
Permutations, Combinations & Generating Functions

products.description: In-depth solved question bank for singly/doubly linked lists, binary search trees, AVL rotations, graph traversals (BFS/DFS), and sorting complexity proofs.
syllabusHighlights: AVL Tree Balancing Rotations (LL, RR, LR, RL)
Infix to Postfix Conversion & Stack Evaluation
Dijkstra's Shortest Path & Kruskal's MST Algorithms
Time & Space Complexity Proofs for QuickSort and MergeSort

products.description: Polymorphism, virtual tables (vptr/vtable), inheritance types, templates, and STL container exam problems solved with detailed commentary.
syllabusHighlights: Virtual Functions, Pure Virtual Destructors & Abstract Classes
Operator Overloading (+, -, <<, >>, []) with Code Traces
Exception Handling Mechanics & Standard Template Library (STL)
Multiple Inheritance & The Diamond Problem Resolution

products.description: ER modeling, normalization proofs (1NF through BCNF), relational algebra, transaction ACID properties, concurrency control, and two-phase locking.
syllabusHighlights: Normalization Proofs (2NF, 3NF, BCNF) with Real Dependencies
Relational Algebra Queries vs SQL Complex Joins
Serializability, Conflict Equivalence & 2-Phase Locking (2PL)
Recovery Protocols: Write-Ahead Logging & Checkpointing

products.description: Process scheduling (SJF, Round Robin), Banker's algorithm for deadlock avoidance, memory paging, segmentation, and disk scheduling algorithms.
syllabusHighlights: Banker's Algorithm for Deadlock Avoidance (Step-by-Step Matrix)
CPU Scheduling Gantt Charts (SJF, SRTF, RR with Context Switches)
Page Replacement Algorithms: FIFO, LRU, Optimal with Page Faults
Critical Section Problem: Peterson's Solution & Semaphores

products.description: OSI 7 layers vs TCP/IP, IP subnetting calculations (CIDR), sliding window protocols, routing algorithms (Distance Vector vs Link State), and DNS/HTTP.
syllabusHighlights: IP Subnetting & Supernetting (VLSM) Numerical Problem Solutions
Sliding Window Flow Control: Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat
Distance Vector (Count to Infinity) vs Link State Routing (OSPF)
TCP 3-Way Handshake, Congestion Window, & Slow Start

products.description: Cryptographic algorithms (DES, AES, RSA mathematical steps), Diffie-Hellman key exchange, digital signatures, hashing (SHA-256), and firewall architectures.
syllabusHighlights: RSA Key Generation & Encryption/Decryption Numerical Examples
Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange with Man-in-the-Middle Scenarios
Symmetric vs Asymmetric Ciphers (AES Structure & S-Boxes)
PKI, Digital Certificates (X.509) and SSL/TLS Handshake
